learning_outcomes.text: To prepare students for engineering practice with a main design experience that will include engineering standards and realistic conditions/constraints (such as economy, environmental problems, sustainability, manufacturability, ethics, health, safety, social and political problems) using the knowledge and skills acquired in previous courses.
